name: Isshi Mizuki
source:
A girl who lives in Katsumi Village. Six months ago, her mother died in a tragic accident and since then has been living alone. The resemblance to her mother is uncanny.

[spoiler]She's the daughter of Mizuho, the protaginist's first love whom he was unable to confess to many years ago.[/spoiler]
